## Tier header
Tier: T4
Why: S-SCHED-2 makes this PR the client of backend #634, which changes who can read scheduling data (assignment-gated coach reads, participant-only sessions) and makes the server the authority for booking validation and no double booking. The mobile commits here consume those contracts. The tier follows the contract they belong to.
T4 trigger scan: The client depends on the new read-access rules (my-coaches is assignment-scoped, session reads are participant-only). No auth, RLS or tenancy primitive is implemented on the client. No CI gate file, schema or destructive persistence. package.json/lock change (expo-calendar ~56.0.8) came from the prior builder and is unchanged in S-SCHED-2.
T3 trigger scan: Cross-repo contract (my-coaches + welcome marker, session_type_id on open slots, include_archived, scope=past + before/before_id and upcoming after/after_id cursors, status filter, expected_start_at on approve/decline/cancel, SESSION_MOVED / INVALID_LIST_QUERY, tel: call links, reschedulable / meeting_link_status / session_type / coach_name / client_name, coded errors), shared notification surface (live row normaliser, role-aware center routing through the push table).
Bounded T1: NO.
Builder-owner: agent 110, lane S-SCHED-2 (Claude Opus 5.5 builder), now the builder of this PR; fix round S-SCHED-3 by agent 111 (builder); fix round S-SCHED-4 by agent 112 (Claude Opus 5.5 builder). Prior T2 builder: GPT-6.1 Sol. Not self-audited.
Acceptance evidence: see Validation. Exact-head CI is listed there once it reports.
Promotion triggers: any change to the access predicate, transition fence or error-code contract in #634, to the call-link contract (https or bounded tel:), to Android blocked permissions, or to push payload keys (actionScreen / actionParams / notificationId).

**Depends on backend [#634](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/634).** Merge #634 first: after it, the server rejects bookings without `session_type_id`. This branch sends it. The legacy-coach fallback keeps Calendar readable against a backend without `/scheduling/my-coaches` (bare 404 only; any coded error surfaces).

## S-SCHED-2 changes (agent 110)
- **Contracts** (`src/api/schedulingApi.ts`):
  - `listMyCoaches` reads `GET /scheduling/my-coaches`, which returns head coach and active sub-coach, avatar, relationship, bookable type count and the persistent `welcome` marker. The fallback is `/v1/clients/me/coach`, on a bare 404 only.
  - `getOpenSlots` sends `session_type_id`, so the server sizes slots to the type and honours type-scoped hours.
  - `listSessionTypes(coachId, { includeArchived })`.
  - `listMySessions(limit, { scope: 'past', before })`.
  - New session fields: `reschedulable`, `meeting_link_status`, `session_type`, `coach_name`, `client_name`.
- **Errors** (`src/calendar/schedulingErrors.ts`): all 19 backend codes have plain next-step copy. `CALENDAR_BUSY` (503) is a definite "not booked", so it does not trigger the uncertain-outcome lock. Slot codes refresh open times.
- **Client Calendar:**
  - Welcome card from the server marker: book it, booked (status + time, opens the session), or done (no card).
  - Past sessions, newest first, with Show earlier sessions (cursor paging). A recap hint is shown when present.
  - Calm call-link line on confirmed sessions without a link.
- **Booking:**
  - Welcome mode picks the type by marker id, then `is_welcome`, then the seed name.
  - If the welcome call is already booked or done, the screen shows that, emits `welcome_call_booked` and offers no second booking.
  - `PENDING_REQUEST_LIMIT`, `WELCOME_ALREADY_BOOKED` and `CALENDAR_BUSY` each get their own message.
  - When the coach has not added a link yet, the success copy says the coach will add it.
- **Session detail:**
  - Server `reschedulable` and `cancellable` are used separately. Under the new server a client can cancel until the start, so the old comment about a 24-hour server lock is corrected. The 24-hour rule is kept only as the fallback for an older backend.
  - A started session explains why it is locked.
  - A pending link shows calm copy.
- **Coach:**
  - Appointment types list every type, archived ones included (server `include_archived`), so archive and restore survive leaving the screen.
  - Welcome call toggle: one per coach, and the server moves it.
  - Default call link with https validation; empty clears it.
  - The welcome and link fields are sent only when they change.
  - The agenda shows the client name and link status ("No call link yet. Add one below so your client can join.").
  - `useUpdateSessionType` writes the saved row into the cache at once.
- **Notifications:**
  - `fetchNotifications` normalises live backend rows (`{id, kind, body, payload{title, actionScreen, actionParams}, read_at, created_at}`) into `AppNotification`. Booking kinds map to coach/reminder, params are sanitised, and screen names are allow-listed.
  - Center taps route through `routeInAppNotification`, which uses the same role-aware table as push taps: client booking goes to Calendar > session, coach booking to the Clients > booking inbox, and flag-off destinations land in the center.
  - Removed the pre-existing `navigation as unknown as` cast in the center.
- **Cache:** the my-coaches welcome marker is invalidated on request, cancel, reschedule, approve, decline, complete, no-show and type create/update.

## S-SCHED (T2) base, prior builder — unchanged history
Fresh branch from main `bb161a3494d9b63e33e07cd454ab4e75d65cb0c0`. Selectively recovered and substantially corrected agent 108 mobile WIP `fa9959ab`; never merged its stale branch.
Current head: `bc1398c29de93ec5318568716c8308ea19ce110a`.

- Real Calendar tab with coach identity, active approved appointment types, two weeks of server-computed slots, upcoming sessions and session details. Uses `/v1/clients/me/coach`, open-slots `duration_minutes` and the actual strict request/reschedule DTOs; no speculative endpoint or fields.
- Booking/request/reschedule/cancel, per-type approval status, server cancellation rules, real call-link Join window, recap display, conflict refresh and duplicate-submit latches. Ambiguous outcomes block blind repeat booking and offer Check Calendar.
- DST-safe absolute instants, repeated local clocks distinguishable by zone abbreviation, client-zone display and server scheduling timezone for coach editors.
- User-controlled Add to my calendar via the OS event editor, with 24-hour and 1-hour calendar alarms. No account linking, full-calendar read or automatic synchronization. Android editor completion is not falsely reported as Save; cancellations and changes explicitly instruct manual copy updates.
- Coach appointment-type create/edit/archive/visit-scoped undo, weekly availability and date/block time off. Coach agenda approves/declines, cancels and has a real HTTPS call-link editor on existing routes.
- Roman tutorial Calendar step and final Book your welcome call with coach action; seeded Quick initialization name preselection, explicit selection fallback if renamed. Flag-off preserves the existing tour.
- Registered role-aware actionScreen destinations. This is route readiness, **not proof of booking push delivery**.
- A session link with missing notification params has an actionable Calendar fallback, never a render crash.
- Known status/machine-code recovery copy, working retry/message/support actions and sanitized unknown-error references reported through Sentry. No raw axios payload/token diagnostics.

`EXPO_PUBLIC_FF_CLIENT_CALENDAR` defaults OFF and is ON in clinic/production build profiles for the requested launch. **Draft: do not merge/release while any prerequisite below remains unresolved.** Google Calendar synchronization, Meet and Zoom remain OFF.


## Remaining prerequisites
1. Backend [#634](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/634) (T4) must merge first. The former prerequisites 1-3 (authoritative validation, delivery/tap contract, history / welcome marker / archive list / default links) are implemented there.
2. `BOOKING_REMINDERS_ENABLED` needs an explicit `on` after #632/#634. Unset means off; see #632's S-ENVTRUTH merge note. Set it through the audited prod-switch manifest after device QA.
3. Add expo-calendar to the shared mobile dependency depot (unchanged from before).
4. Independent audit and iOS/Android device acceptance (event editor, push tap, center tap) have not run.
5. Legacy `ClientBookingRequest` route (pre-existing, no navigate callers, not in the push table) sends no `session_type_id` and would now get `SESSION_TYPE_REQUIRED`. It is unreachable. Recommend deleting it in a follow-up.

## Validation (S-SCHED-2 head)
Head `b0c02156dd86f00e0bfef80a7b517c46ddfb8f2d`. All heavy commands ran through the shared heavy queue, with targeted Jest only.
- `npx jest --runInBand --forceExit src/api/__tests__/schedulingApi.test.ts src/calendar/__tests__/schedulingErrors.test.ts src/screens/client/calendar/__tests__/calendarScreens.test.tsx src/screens/coach/__tests__/coachSchedulingSettings.test.tsx src/services/__tests__/notificationsNormalize.test.ts src/services/__tests__/pushTapRouter.test.ts src/__tests__/notificationCenter.test.tsx src/screens/__tests__/conciergePhase1.test.tsx`: **8 suites / 145 tests passed**. `--forceExit` was used because the local single-process runner does not exit by itself (disclosed by the prior builder).
- Neighbour suites (useNotifications, imessageDmRoutes, tutorial flag/copy, calendarTime, phoneCalendar with expo-calendar mocked): **6 suites / 63 tests passed** (`npx jest --runInBand --forceExit src/hooks/__tests__/useNotifications.test.tsx src/navigation/__tests__/imessageDmRoutes.test.tsx src/tutorial/__tests__/tutorialCalendarFlag.test.ts src/tutorial/__tests__/tutorialCopy.test.ts src/calendar/__tests__/calendarTime.test.ts src/calendar/__tests__/phoneCalendar.test.ts`).
- `npx tsc --noEmit` (shared deps): the only errors are the 2 pre-existing `expo-calendar/legacy` module-not-found errors, because the shared depot lacks the package. CI installs the lock graph.
- `npx eslint` on the 18 changed files: 0 errors, 1 pre-existing warning (unused `useState` import in NotificationCenterScreen, present at bc1398c2).
- Banned tokens on changed files (bc1398c2 to head): `as unknown as` 1 to 0, `@ts-expect-error` 2 to 2, the other classes 0 to 0.
- `git merge-tree` against mobile main e3986e8: clean.
- CI at head: [Typecheck, lint, test](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/pull/325/checks) **PASS** (full installed-lock-graph suite), plus Analyze (js-ts), Analyze (actions) and CodeQL **PASS**.

## Validation (S-SCHED-3 head)
Head `13b8a8fa2fccc276031e4819846f62c97616db6e` (main e3986e89 merged as `d0873d3`, merge commit, no rebase; main has not moved since). package.json unchanged.
- `env CI=true npx jest --runInBand --forceExit src/api/__tests__/schedulingCallLinkAndCursor.test.ts src/calendar/__tests__ src/config/__tests__/calendarPermissionsBlocked.test.js src/config/__tests__/androidHealthConnectConfig.test.js src/screens/coach/__tests__/coachSchedulingFixRound.test.tsx src/screens/coach/__tests__/coachSchedulingSettings.test.tsx src/screens/client/calendar/__tests__ src/screens/__tests__/conciergePhase1.test.tsx src/hooks/__tests__/useScheduling.test.ts`: **11 suites / 157 tests passed** (coach fix-round file re-run 10/10 after a test-regex fix).
- Neighbours: `src/api/__tests__/schedulingApi.test.ts src/services/__tests__/pushTapRouter.test.ts src/__tests__/notificationCenter.test.tsx src/screens/client/__tests__`: **17 suites / 156 passed**; `scripts/__tests__/validateAppConfig.test.js src/screens/settings`: **87 passed**; `node scripts/validate-app-config.js` OK; vendor-name guard passed.
- Failing-before: the new and changed cases run on the pre-fix sources (source files stashed, tests kept): **48 fail** across every finding below; the remaining 80 are existing or guard cases.
- `npx tsc --noEmit` (NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=3584): only the 2 pre-existing `expo-calendar/legacy` module-not-found errors (shared depot). eslint on the 21 changed files: 0 errors, 0 warnings.
